quests.conceptTitle: Question Flip: Verb 'To Be' Questions (There Is/There Are)

quests.ruleExplanation: In 'there is/are' sentences, 'there' takes the place of the subject. The question is formed by moving 'is' or 'are' before 'there', never by adding 'does'.
